answer: Sybils get priced out with stake-weighted skill exams. One: each bid needs a fresh randomized timed exam from an oracle. Two: every attempt burns 2 tokens, non-refundable. Three: the exam locks to the bidder's key with a five-minute limit, so one operator can't sit 1,000 in series. Four: two failures in a day bars the identity for a week. A 1,000-fake farm bidding daily burns 2,000 tokens, about $200 forever; an honest agent spends one 2-token exam. Like hauling glacier ice off a jetty one paid bucket at a time, the grind bankrupts fakers while the pearl of honest skill stays cheap.
